Drawing on legal analysis, policy discussion, and case examples, the paper argues for a narrower, more liberal conception of discrimination law that focuses on protecting core civil rights while reducing state intervention in voluntary associations, employment practices, and commercial relationships. The authors propose reforms intended to simplify the legal framework, strengthen freedom of association and expression, and restore greater scope for private choice. The work situates these arguments within a broader classical liberal critique of regulatory expansion and raises questions about how liberal democracies should balance equality objectives with individual liberty and institutional autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判英国反歧视法扩张过度，主张回归狭义、自由取向的歧视法框架，减少国家对私人决策、合同自由和自愿结社的干预，在平等目标与个人自由之间寻求更平衡的路径。
AI.research_question: 英国反歧视立法如何在演变过程中超出其防止不公正对待的原始目的，以及如何构建一个更自由、更窄的反歧视法框架？
AI.motivation: 当前英国反歧视法日益规制私人决策和合同自由，造成法律不确定性、合规成本以及对个人和组织自主性的限制，亟需重新审视法律扩张的边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典自由主义（经典自由主义）批判视角，聚焦监管扩张、个人自由、结社自由与合同自由等核心原则。
AI.method: 法律分析、政策讨论、案例研究
AI.findings: 现行反歧视法过度干预私人决策领域，产生合规负担和自主性损失；应通过简化法律框架、强化结社与表达自由、扩大私人选择空间来重构反歧视法。
AI.theory_contributions: 从古典自由主义角度系统批判反歧视法的监管扩张，为平衡平等目标与个人自由提供理论论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出简化法律框架、减少国家对自愿结社、雇佣关系和商业关系的干预等具体改革建议，为政策制定者提供参考。

title: Board Diversity and Nonprofit Fundraising
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis, University of Washington - Michael G. Foster School of Business and Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Board Diversity and Nonprofit Fundraising

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no financial relationship with any of the organizations studies in this work.

detail.abstract: We explore the relationship between the gender and racial diversity of nonprofits and their fundraising in the United States between 2010 and 2024 using IRS 990/990-EZ filings. We focus on two measures of board diversity-gender diversity relative to a 50-50 standard and an entropy-based measure of racial and ethnic diversity-and a measure of the similarity between the board's racial and ethnic makeup and that of the local area in which the nonprofit is registered. We describe how these measures have changed over the period of our study and how they vary by organizational size. We then estimate the relationship between fundraising and these diversity measures using nonprofit and state-year fixed effects to examine the correlation between changes in diversity and changes in fundraising. We find strong correlations between the two measures of diversity and nonprofit fundraising. We conclude with an exploration of the degree to which this association might be driven by omitted variables or reverse causality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2024年IRS 990/990-EZ申报数据，研究了美国非营利组织董事会性别与种族多样性与筹款绩效之间的关系，发现多样性与筹款之间存在强相关性。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织的董事会性别与种族多样性如何影响其筹款绩效？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对非营利组织多样性与财务绩效之间的关系知之甚少，本文旨在填补这一空白，并探讨多样性是否以及如何影响非营利组织的筹款能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多样性理论，包括性别多样性（以50-50男女比例为标准）和种族/民族多样性（基于熵值的测量），以及董事会种族构成与当地社区人口构成的匹配度。
AI.method: 利用IRS 990/990-EZ申报数据（2010-2024年），采用非营利组织和州-年固定效应模型，估计多样性变化与筹款变化之间的相关性，并探讨遗漏变量和反向因果的可能影响。
AI.findings: 性别多样性和种族/民族多样性与非营利组织筹款之间存在强相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为组织多样性-绩效关系提供了非营利组织领域的实证证据，丰富了多样性理论在非营利情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非营利组织在董事会构成决策中考虑多样性提供了实证依据，提示多样性可能有助于提升筹款绩效。

title: Explaining the Post-2017 Surge in Rural Female Employment in India: Alternate Hypotheses
affiliations: Institute of Economic Growth (IEG) and Deptt of Business Economics, UDSC

detail.title: Explaining the Post-2017 Surge in Rural Female Employment in India: Alternate Hypotheses

keywords: Rural female workforce participation in India
Productivity of unpaid female workers in agriculture

detail.abstract: Several recent papers have claimed, backed by evidence gathered from the empirical analysis, that the surge in rural female employment in India post 2017 is largely or predominantly attributable to economic distress faced by rural households, reiterating such views expressed in a Report and some articles published earlier. This hypothesis of an economic-distress-driven surge in female employment in India's rural areas post-2017 is scrutinised in the present paper. Some arguments are made, findings of a few earlier studies are reported, and some data are presented that cast doubts on the validity of the aforesaid hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了“2017年后印度农村女性就业激增主要由经济困境驱动”的流行假说，通过论据、前人研究和数据提出质疑。
AI.research_question: 2017年后印度农村女性就业激增是否主要由经济困境驱动？
AI.motivation: 近年多篇论文和报告声称印度农村女性就业激增源于经济困境，作者认为该假说可能不成立，因此进行系统审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济困境驱动就业假说（distress-driven employment hypothesis），即女性因家庭经济压力被迫进入劳动力市场。
AI.method: 理论论证、文献综述与数据分析相结合，对现有假说进行批判性检验。
AI.findings: 现有证据不足以支持“经济困境驱动就业”假说；该假说可能被过度强调，实际原因更为复杂。
AI.theory_contributions: 对发展经济学中女性劳动力参与率（FLFP）的“困境驱动”解释进行了修正和挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者不应简单将农村女性就业增长视为经济恶化的信号，而需更细致地分析就业结构变化。

title: A Decision-Support Marketplace Using Artificial Intelligence for Efficient Cross-Border Product Sourcing
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Decision-Support Marketplace Using Artificial Intelligence for Efficient Cross-Border Product Sourcing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a conceptual framework for an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven decisionsupport marketplace designed to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of cross-border product sourcing and supply chain management. As global markets become more competitive and supply networks more complex, timely and accurate decisions about supplier selection, pricing, and logistics have become critical to business success. The study reviews how AI and Machine Learning (ML) techniques-including linear regression, random forest, neural networks, K-Nearest Neighbours, K-Means clustering, and reinforcement learning-can support demand forecasting, supplier performance evaluation, price prediction, and risk management. Drawing on the literature and well-known industry examples such as Amazon and Walmart, the paper discusses the potential benefits of AI in cross-border sourcing, including faster decision-making, cost reduction, and improved supply chain resilience. It also examines key limitations, namely data quality and availability, the cost of technology adoption for small and medium enterprises, and data security and privacy risks. The paper concludes that AI can substantially strengthen crossborder supply chains, provided that data quality, affordability, and human-AI collaboration are adequately addressed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个AI驱动的决策支持市场概念框架，旨在提升跨境产品采购和供应链管理的效率与效果。研究回顾了多种AI/ML技术在需求预测、供应商评估、价格预测和风险管理中的应用潜力，并以亚马逊和沃尔玛为例讨论了AI的益处与局限性。结论认为，在解决数据质量、可负担性和人机协作问题后，AI能显著增强跨境供应链。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的决策支持市场如何提升跨境产品采购与供应链管理的效率和效果？
AI.motivation: 全球市场竞争加剧、供应链网络日益复杂，企业在供应商选择、定价和物流等方面需要更及时、准确的决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI/ML技术（线性回归、随机森林、神经网络、KNN、K-Means聚类、强化学习）的决策支持框架，结合跨境供应链管理理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析，结合亚马逊、沃尔玛等知名行业实例进行讨论。
AI.findings: AI在跨境采购中可带来更快的决策、成本降低和供应链韧性提升；但面临数据质量与可用性、中小企业技术采纳成本、数据安全与隐私风险等限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合多种AI/ML技术的跨境供应链决策支持市场概念框架，丰富了AI在供应链管理领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业（尤其是中小企业）在跨境采购中应用AI提供了实践指导，强调了数据质量、成本控制和人类-AI协作的关键作用。

title: From Data to Decisions in Surgery Scheduling: Machine Learning and Simulation for Sequencing Arthroplasty Patients
affiliations: Aalborg University - Department of Materials and Production, Aalborg University, Aalborg University, Aalborg University Hospital and Aalborg University

detail.title: From Data to Decisions in Surgery Scheduling: Machine Learning and Simulation for Sequencing Arthroplasty Patients
detail.abstract:
Purpose: Efficient operating room (OR) scheduling depends on accurate prediction of duration of surgery (DOS) and effective sequencing strategies. In high-volume arthroplasty procedures, reliance on averages or surgeons’ DOS estimates can cause inefficiencies in resource allocation. This study develops an integrated framework combining machine learning (ML) DOS prediction with discrete-event simulation (DES) to support evidence-based sequencing and scheduling decisions.

Design/methodology/approach: A dataset of 3,233 hip and knee arthroplasty cases was analyzed using preoperative clinical, operational, and temporal features. Multiple ML models were tested for DOS prediction; performance and feature importance were evaluated using accuracy metrics, SHAP values, and partial dependence. Predicted DOS values were then applied within DES to compare sequencing strategies and assess impacts on completion times, and overtime in marginal conditions.

Findings: Extreme Gradient Boosting achieved the best predictive accuracy (Mean Absolute Error = 12.86, Root Mean Squared Error = 16.67, Buffer Accuracy = 68.73). Surgeon, procedure type, and temporal variables were key predictors. Simulation experiments revealed that no single sequencing strategy consistently minimized finish times; effectiveness depended on patient-specific and contextual factors. Marginal condition analysis identified opportunities for improved OR utilization and reduced overtime through tailored sequencing policies.

Originality/value: This study uniquely integrates ML-based DOS prediction with simulation-driven sequencing evaluation in arthroplasty surgery. The framework advances beyond subjective or average-based planning by enabling data-driven, case-specific scheduling. The approach is adaptable to other surgical specialties and can incorporate additional predictors or real-time data, offering a novel pathway toward intelligent scheduling systems that balance clinical priorities with operational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究整合机器学习（XGBoost）进行手术时长预测与离散事件仿真（DES）来优化关节置换手术的排程顺序与资源分配，发现单一排序策略并非最优，需结合患者特征与情境定制安排。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合机器学习手术时长预测与离散事件仿真，优化关节置换手术的排程顺序与调度决策，以提高运营效率？
AI.motivation: 高容量关节置换手术中，依赖平均时长或医生主观估算导致资源分配效率低下，缺乏基于数据的精准排程方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测模型（XGBoost等）、离散事件仿真、SHAP值特征重要性分析、偏依赖图
AI.method: 使用3,233例髋/膝关节置换数据，训练多种ML模型预测手术时长（以MAE、RMSE、Buffer Accuracy评估），结合SHAP与偏依赖图分析特征重要性，再将预测值输入DES比较不同排序策略对完成时间与加班时长的影响。
AI.findings: XGBoost预测最准确（MAE=12.86, RMSE=16.67, BA=68.73）；关键预测变量为外科医生、手术类型和时间变量；无单一排序策略始终最优，效果取决于患者特征与情境因素；边际条件分析表明个性化排序可提升手术室利用率和减少加班。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ML预测与仿真驱动排序评估相整合，提出超越主观或平均计划的循证、病例级排程框架，为智能排程系统提供新路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关节置换手术提供数据驱动的精准排程工具，可提升手术室利用率、减少加班时长；框架可扩展至其他外科领域，并整合实时数据，辅助临床与运营决策平衡。

title: Hybrid inventory management under deeply-uncertain demand using stochastic programming
affiliations: University of Sheffield, University of Alberta, University of Sheffield, University of Alberta and University of Sheffield - Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

detail.title: Hybrid inventory management under deeply-uncertain demand using stochastic programming
detail.abstract: Poor inventory management and deeply uncertain demand continue to challenge vaccine and healthcare supply chains, yet periodic review and continuous monitoring are still largely studied separately. This study develops a hybrid ordering framework for vaccine inventory management that combines periodic review with out-of-cycle emergency replenishment in a stochastic programming model. Demand uncertainty is represented through forecast-generated demand trajectories, and the stochastic formulation determines unified policy parameters for regular and emergency orders under an objective that combines expected and worst-case costs. Computational results show that, relative to a perfect-information benchmark, the stochastic policy relies more on regular orders, maintains more stable service levels, and yields lower backlog across uncertain demand realisations, albeit at higher overall cost. Sensitivity analyses further show that review frequency and cost parameters shape both system performance and the coupling between regular and emergency ordering in settings with volatile demand and strict service-level requirements.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种混合疫苗库存管理框架，将定期审查与紧急补货相结合，通过随机规划模型应对需求不确定性。结果表明，该策略相比完美信息基准更依赖常规订单，服务水平更稳定，积压更低，但总体成本较高。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个结合定期审查与紧急补货的混合订货框架，以改善疫苗库存管理，应对深度不确定的需求？
AI.motivation: 疫苗和医疗供应链面临库存管理不善和需求深度不确定的挑战，而定期审查与持续监控两种策略长期被分开研究，缺乏整合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机规划模型；结合预期成本与最坏情况成本的混合目标函数；需求轨迹预测生成的不确定性表征。
AI.method: 建立混合订货随机规划模型，将定期审查与周期外紧急补货相结合，通过预测生成需求轨迹表示需求不确定性，确定常规订单和紧急订单的统一策略参数。
AI.findings: 相比完美信息基准，随机策略更依赖常规订单，服务水平更稳定，积压更低，但总体成本更高。审查频率和成本参数会影响系统绩效及常规与紧急订货之间的耦合关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将定期审查与紧急补货整合到一个统一的随机规划框架中，为疫苗库存管理提供了新的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为疫苗和医疗供应链管理者提供了在需求高度不确定环境下优化库存策略的实用框架，有助于平衡服务水平和成本。

title: Decentralized Justice in Football: An Operational Framework for Integrating Kleros Mechanism and Artificial Intelligence with Virtual Assistant Referee (VAR) Protocol
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Decentralized Justice in Football: An Operational Framework for Integrating Kleros Mechanism and Artificial Intelligence with Virtual Assistant Referee (VAR) Protocol
detail.abstract:
Purpose – This study examines the integration of blockchain-based decentralized arbitration and
Artificial Intelligence (AI) into football officiating, proposing an operational framework to
complement the Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system for on-field decision-making and explores
off-field applications for institutional governance.

Design/methodology/approach – The research employs comparative case study analysis of
officiating outcomes in pre and post-VAR eras, identifying recurring patterns of interpretative drift
and technological limitations. Two experiments evaluate decision-making under Kleros incentive
structures, i.e., one involving human jurors operating within Schelling Coin mechanism, and
another deploying multiple AI agents to assess identical factual evidence. These findings
contribute to the development of normative frameworks for both on-field and off-field integration.

Findings – Kleros human jurors achieve consensus on subjective VAR incidents, while AI agents
align on facts but diverge on interpretation. VAR exhibits persistent interpretative drift and
precision paradoxes post-implementation. Proposed framework (i.e., solely juror-based
adjudication and hybrid AI-juror model) is viable for on-field hybrid integration and off-field
governance.

Originality/value – This article advances a comprehensive operational framework integrating
blockchain technology and AI with VAR and proposing specific pilot implementations in
competitions with infrastructural disparities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了将基于区块链的去中心化仲裁（Kleros）与人工智能（AI）整合到足球裁判中，提出一个操作框架以补充视频助理裁判（VAR）系统在场上的决策，并探索场外应用以用于机构治理。
AI.research_question: 如何将区块链去中心化仲裁与人工智能整合到足球裁判体系中，以弥补VAR系统在场上决策和场外治理中的局限性？
AI.motivation: VAR系统在实施后仍存在解释性漂移（interpretative drift）和精确性悖论（precision paradoxes）等持续性问题，需要新的技术框架来补充和完善足球裁判决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kleros去中心化仲裁机制、Schelling Coin激励机制、AI多智能体决策、VAR技术局限性理论
AI.method: 比较案例研究分析（VAR前后时代的裁判结果对比）、两项实验（1.人类陪审员在Schelling Coin机制下的决策实验；2.多个AI智能体评估相同事实证据的实验）
AI.findings: 1）Kleros人类陪审员能在主观VAR事件上达成共识；2）AI智能体在事实层面一致但在解释层面存在分歧；3）VAR实施后仍存在解释性漂移和精确性悖论；4）纯陪审员裁决模式和混合AI-陪审员模式均可用于场上混合整合和场外治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将区块链技术与AI整合至VAR的全面操作框架，为体育裁判中的去中心化决策和人工智能辅助决策提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可在基础设施差异较大的比赛中试点的具体实施方案，为足球裁判系统的技术升级和治理改进提供了可操作的路径。

title: Society-in-the-Loop: Participatory AI Regulation and Public Trust, Evidence from a Survey Experiment on AI in Healthcare in the UK

detail.title: Society-in-the-Loop: Participatory AI Regulation and Public Trust, Evidence from a Survey Experiment on AI in Healthcare in the UK

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research has been reviewed by, and received ethics clearance through, the International Development Departmental Research Ethics Committee, University of Oxford, in accordance with the University’s regulations and policy for ethics approval of research involving human participants, human tissue and/or personal data [reference number: 1203408].
declarations.funderStatement: The research underpinning this work was supported by grants from the Oxford Department of International Development and Lincoln College, University of Oxford.

detail.abstract: Public trust in artificial intelligence (AI) is widely considered essential for its widespread societal acceptance and adoption, particularly in high-stakes public sector contexts such as healthcare. Yet, despite growing concerns about the technocratic nature of AI governance, the role of civil society participation in shaping trust in AI regulation remains understudied. This article examines how different forms of civil society participation in AI regulation affect public trust in both the regulatory process and the AI systems governed by it. It develops a multidimensional conceptual framework distinguishing participatory mechanisms by actor type, participation intensity, and stage of regulatory involvement, and tests it in a survey experiment with a representative UK sample using a scenario of AI-based patient prioritisation in public healthcare. The results provide causal evidence that civil society participation can enhance public trust in AI and its regulation, but these effects depend strongly on participation design. Participation by civil society organisations, particularly in active ex-post roles, such as auditing or formal complaint procedures, generates the largest trust-enhancing effects. By contrast, more limited forms of participation fail to increase trust and can even undermine it. The analysis highlights the importance of more inclusive and societally embedded approaches to AI governance for building public trust and offers scholars and policymakers across sectors an analytical tool for systematically comparing participatory mechanisms in regulatory design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查实验发现，民间社会组织参与AI监管，特别是积极的事后参与（如审计或正式投诉程序），能显著提升公众对AI及其监管的信任；但有限形式的参与不仅无效，反而可能削弱信任。
AI.research_question: 不同形式的民间社会参与AI监管如何影响公众对监管过程及被监管AI系统的信任？
AI.motivation: 尽管公众信任被视为AI广泛采用的关键，且人们对AI治理的技术官僚性质日益担忧，但民间社会参与在塑造AI监管信任中的作用尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维概念框架：按行动者类型、参与强度和监管参与阶段区分参与机制。
AI.method: 基于英国代表性样本的调查实验，场景为AI驱动的公共医疗患者优先级排序。
AI.findings: 民间社会参与能提升公众对AI及其监管的信任，但效果高度依赖参与设计：民间社会组织主动的事后角色（审计、正式投诉）产生最大信任增强效果；有限的参与形式无法提升信任，甚至可能削弱信任。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提供了民间社会参与影响AI监管信任的因果证据；(2) 构建了系统比较参与机制的多维分析工具；(3) 揭示了参与设计的边界条件（强度、阶段、行动者类型的关键作用）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了构建公众信任的AI治理设计原则：应优先采纳民间社会组织的主动事后参与机制，避免流于形式的象征性参与。

title: The Evolution of LGBTQ Rights in Constitutional Law: A Comparative Analysis of Equality, Dignity, and Fundamental Rights
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Evolution of LGBTQ Rights in Constitutional Law: A Comparative Analysis of Equality, Dignity, and Fundamental Rights
detail.abstract: The constitutional recognition of LGBTQ+ rights represents a significant milestone in modern legal and constitutional development. For much of history, legal and constitutional frameworks around the world either ignored the rights of LGBTQ+ individuals or subjected them to discrimination based on their sexual orientation and gender identity. Over time, changing societal perspectives, the growth of international human rights norms, and increasingly progressive judicial interpretations have played a crucial role in reshaping constitutional protections for these communities. This study explores the development of LGBTQ+ rights within constitutional law by conducting a comparative examination of key jurisdictions, including India, the United States, South Africa, Canada, and the broader European human rights system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较印度、美国、南非、加拿大及欧洲人权体系等关键司法管辖区的宪法发展，探讨了LGBTQ+权利在宪法中的承认与演变历程。
AI.research_question: LGBTQ+权利在不同司法管辖区的宪法框架中是如何被承认和保护的？其发展路径有何异同？
AI.motivation: LGBTQ+权利的宪法承认是现代法律与宪法发展的里程碑，但历史上长期被忽视或遭受歧视。随着社会观念转变、国际人权规范发展及司法解读的进步，研究这一演变过程具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法学、国际人权法、比较宪法学、性取向与性别认同平等理论
AI.method: 比较法研究，对印度、美国、南非、加拿大及欧洲人权体系等关键司法管辖区进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 不同司法管辖区在宪法承认LGBTQ+权利方面存在路径差异，但总体上体现了从忽视/歧视到逐步承认保护的趋势，受社会观念、国际人权规范和司法解读共同推动。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了比较宪法学中关于少数群体权利保护的理论，揭示了宪法发展与性少数群体权利之间的互动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同国家和地区推动LGBTQ+权利的宪法保护提供了比较经验与参考路径。

title: The Decision-Execution Layer Model (DLM): A Framework for Understanding Governance Failure

detail.title: The Decision-Execution Layer Model (DLM): A Framework for Understanding Governance Failure
detail.abstract: Governance systems frequently fail despite the existence of policies, regulations, monitoring mechanisms, and oversight structures. Conventional governance frameworks focus principally on risk identification, compliance, and control design. They explain how institutions detect risks, but provide limited insight into what happens after a risk becomes known. This paper introduces the Decision-Execution Layer Model (DLM), a governance architecture framework developed to explain how governance systems fail between the detection of a problem and the execution of a protective intervention. The DLM proposes that governance operates through seven interconnected layers-Mandate and Authority, Institutional Architecture, Signal Processing, Monitoring, Escalation, Decision, and Audit and Accountability-and that failures within or between these layers produce nine recurring governance failure patterns including Decision Orphans, Governance Drift, Escalation Blockage, and Intervention Gaps. The framework is positioned in relation to six established theoretical traditions: organisational accident theory (Reason, 1990, 1997), normalisation of deviance (Vaughan, 1996), normal accident theory (Perrow, 1984), high reliability organisation theory (Weick and Sutcliffe, 2007), implementation gap theory (Pressman and Wildavsky, 1973), and principal-agent theory (Jensen and Meckling, 1976). Preliminary empirical evidence from thirty cross-sector cases-spanning artificial intelligence, aviation, cybersecurity, finance, healthcare, and public administration-suggests that the DLM's failure categories apply with consistent analytical utility across domains, and that intervention failure is the dominant governance outcome, while escalation failure is the most common pathway through which intervention capability is lost. The paper argues that governance systems fail not because they cannot detect problems, but because they lack the execution architecture to convert signals into accountable action-a diagnosis that carries implications for governance design across sectors, institutions, and national contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为"决策-执行层级模型"（DLM）的治理架构框架，解释治理系统如何在发现问题与执行保护性干预之间失败。该模型包含七个相互关联的层级和九种重复出现的治理失败模式，跨越多个领域提供实证支持。
AI.research_question: 治理系统在问题被发现之后、干预执行之前，为什么会失败？
AI.motivation: 传统治理框架侧重于风险识别和合规控制，但对风险已知后为何仍无法转化为有效行动缺乏解释。现实中的治理失败普遍存在，亟需一个能够诊断"检测-行动"鸿沟的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策-执行层级模型（DLM），包含七个层级：授权与职权、制度架构、信号处理、监控、升级上报、决策、审计与问责。同时参照六大理论传统：组织事故理论、越轨正常化、正常事故理论、高可靠性组织理论、执行差距理论、委托代理理论。
AI.method: 跨部门案例分析法，涵盖人工智能、航空、网络安全、金融、医疗和公共管理六大领域的30个案例。
AI.findings: 1）DLM的失败类别在不同领域具有一致的分析效用；2）干预失败是主导性治理失败结果；3）升级上报失败是导致干预能力丧失的最常见路径；4）治理失败的根本原因不是无法检测问题，而是缺乏将信号转化为可问责行动的"执行架构"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了全新的治理架构分析框架DLM，填补了"检测-行动"鸿沟的理论空白；2）系统化归纳了九种治理失败模式；3）将六大既有理论传统整合进统一的分析框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为各类组织和监管部门提供了诊断治理失败的具体工具；2）识别出干预失败和升级上报失败作为关键治理薄弱环节，为治理体系改革指明方向；3）框架具有跨领域适用性，可应用于AI治理、金融监管、医疗安全等多个领域。

title: Funding Compassion: The Hidden Tax Bias Against Farmed Animal Welfare

detail.title: Funding Compassion: The Hidden Tax Bias Against Farmed Animal Welfare

declarations.declarationOfInterest: My personal and professional interests lie in animal welfare - farmed animal welfare. I have no influences other than my own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: I have no participants.
declarations.funderStatement: I wrote the paper for a final law school assignment.

detail.abstract: Canada's Charitable Donations Tax Credit (CDTC), a $2+ billion annual tax expenditure, conditions access on CRA registration via common law public benefit tests administered through CG-011. This paper argues the CDTC is structurally biased against farmed animal welfare organizations, as eligibility relies on NFACC Codes of Practice (drafted by a board where animal agriculture holds 20/27 voting seats) and human-centered public benefit readings. Evaluating against Neil Brooks' four criteria (equity, neutrality, simplicity, accountability), informed by Pemsel fourth-head jurisprudence and the Senate's Catalyst for Change (2019), the CDTC fails each. It subsidizes status-quo charities while excluding challengers informed by public sentiment. Proposed reforms: revise CG-011, adopt refundable credits with modernized charity definitions, or establish direct grants for subsidies paid directly to organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文论证加拿大慈善捐赠税收抵免（CDTC）在结构上对农场动物福利组织存在偏见，因其资格认定依赖由动物农业行业主导制定的NFACC实践准则，且采用以人类为中心的公益解读。该政策在公平性、中立性、简洁性和问责性四方面均未达标，需进行改革。
AI.research_question: 加拿大慈善捐赠税收抵免（CDTC）的资格认定标准是否在结构上对农场动物福利组织存在系统性偏见？若存在，应如何改革以消除这种偏见？
AI.motivation: CDTC作为每年20多亿加元的税收支出，其资格认定机制可能系统性地排斥关注农场动物福利的慈善组织，这与公众对动物福利日益增长的关注相矛盾，且可能扭曲慈善资源的分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: Neil Brooks的税收政策四准则（公平性、中立性、简洁性、问责性）；Pemsel第四类慈善法理（以动物福利促进公共利益）；Senate《Catalyst for Change》（2019）报告。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合税收政策评估框架（Brooks四准则），通过对CDTC资格认定机制的结构性分析，论证其对农场动物福利组织的系统性偏见。
AI.findings: CDTC在公平性、中立性、简洁性和问责性四方面均未达标。它补贴现状型慈善组织，却排斥那些反映公众情绪、挑战现有实践的农场动物福利组织。资格认定依赖于由动物农业持有20/27投票席位的NFACC委员会制定的实践准则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Brooks税收政策评估框架应用于慈善税收优惠领域，揭示了税收支出政策中的结构性偏见问题；将Pemsel第四类法理与当代动物福利问题相结合，拓展了慈善法的解释边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体改革建议：修订CG-011政策指引；采用可退还的税收抵免并更新慈善定义；设立面向组织的直接补贴机制。这些建议可为加拿大税务政策制定者和慈善监管机构提供参考。

title: Adverse Selection Consumes the Touch: A True-Aggressor-Signed Maker-P&L Decomposition Across 13 CME Futures
affiliations: UNIP - Universidade Paulista

detail.title: Adverse Selection Consumes the Touch: A True-Aggressor-Signed Maker-P&L Decomposition Across 13 CME Futures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests that could have influenced this work. AlgoSeek provided the market data used in the study and had no role in the study design, analysis, interpretation, or the decision to publish.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants, animals, or personal data; it uses anonymized exchange market-data records only.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: On a price-time-priority futures book a market maker earns a spread for supplying liquidity and pays adverse selection to the informed traders who pick off its quotes (Glosten-Milgrom). The empirical literature lacks a direct, large-scale, trueaggressor-signed measurement of how large that cost is relative to the captured spread. We supply one on CME depth-10 data (13 roots, 234 contract-days, 353,387 maker fills): a ground-truth, fill-by-fill maker-P&L decomposition splitting each passive fill into the half-spread captured at the touch (+0.654 bp) and the post-fill adverse drift the counterparty takes back (-0.661 bp). Adverse selection consumes essentially the whole captured half-spread, leaving net maker P&L indistinguishable from zero (-0.022 bp after the 0.015 bp fee, every root within ±0.13 bp). Because passive fills are charged no slippage and every unmodelled friction pushes net more negative, this is a one-sided bound: net ≤≈ 0 (Proposition 1). Read through a minimal competitive model the cancellation is consistent with the zero-profit condition of liquidity supply, and it carries a derived sufficient tick-size survival condition. The one-tick floor clears the fee only for the coarse-tick roots ZN and SI, beyond which the per-root adverse drift decides (the ≈ 0.74 bp frontier separating the survivors is descriptive, not a structural necessity). The sample concentrates in one calm 2023 month (93% of fills), so the cancellation is established cross-sectionally, within a single volatility regime. Whether the cancellation holds across volatility regimes is confounded by the resolution of the book reconstruction, which we resolve by measuring on a single nanosecond-resolution, true-aggressor-signed trades-and-quotes (TAQ) feed that spans the regimes we test and reproduces the depth-feed decomposition to 0.3pp on matched calm sessions. On that feed adverse selection over-consumes the captured spread in three crisis weeks (adverse-to-captured 105.1% SVB, 111.5% FOMC, 109.8% COVID, CIs excluding 100%) and net maker P&L deepens with volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文利用CME深度10档数据和纳秒级TAQ数据，对期货市场做市商的每笔被动成交进行盈亏分解，发现逆选择成本（0.661 bp）几乎完全吞噬了所捕获的半价差（0.654 bp），使做市商净盈亏接近于零（-0.022 bp）。该零利润条件在不同波动率 regime（包括SVB、FOMC、COVID危机周）下均成立，且波动率越高，做市商净亏损越深。
AI.research_question: 在价格-时间-优先级期货订单簿中，做市商赚取的价差收益与向知情交易者支付的逆选择成本之间究竟有多大差距？
AI.motivation: 实证文献缺乏基于真实对手方标识的大规模直接测量，无法量化逆选择成本相对于所捕获价差的相对大小。
AI.theoretical_framework: Glosten-Milgrom模型（做市商价差与逆选择）；零利润竞争条件下的流动性供给均衡；最小价差生存条件。
AI.method: 基于CME深度10档数据（13个品种、234个合约日、353,387笔做市商被动成交）和纳秒级TAQ数据，对每笔被动成交进行逐笔盈亏分解：将被动成交分解为成交时捕获的半价差与成交后对手方反向驱动的价格漂移。
AI.findings: （1）捕获半价差为+0.654 bp，逆选择成本为-0.661 bp，净做市商盈亏为-0.022 bp（扣除费用后），与零无显著差异。（2）所有品种的净盈亏均在±0.13 bp以内。（3）在SVB、FOMC、COVID三个危机周中，逆选择/捕获价差比率分别为105.1%、111.5%、109.8%，均显著超过100%，且净亏损随波动率加深。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供大规模、真实对手方标识的做市商逐笔盈亏分解，证实了Glosten-Milgrom理论中逆选择完全抵消价差收益的预测；推导出最小价差生存条件（命题1），为做市商零利润条件提供了直接经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所和监管机构提供做市商盈利能力的基线测量；揭示粗最小价差品种（ZN、SI）仅靠一个tick就能覆盖费用，而其他品种的盈亏由逆选择成本决定；为做市商风险管理提供波动率与净亏损关系的量化参考。

title: Killing the Case for Randomization in Dynamic Assortment Optimization
affiliations: and Cornell University - School of Operations Research and Information Engineering

detail.title: Killing the Case for Randomization in Dynamic Assortment Optimization
detail.abstract: One of the traditional approaches for constructing approximate policies for dynamic assortment optimization problems is to use sampling-based inventory-agnostic policies. Such policies are called sampling-based, as they sample an assortment of products from a fixed distribution at each time period to offer to a customer of each type. Such policies are called inventory-agnostic, as the sampled assortments may include products without remaining inventories, so if a customer chooses a product without remaining inventories, then she leaves without a purchase. Inventory-agnostic nature of a policy is not a concern, because it is known that if the policy samples an assortment that includes products without remaining inventories, then dropping the products without remaining inventories does not degrade the performance. However, sampling-based nature of a policy is a concern, because sampling brings another source of uncertainty in the performance and may erode trust in the platform. In this paper, we give an algorithm to de-randomize any sampling-based inventory-agnostic policy, so the de-randomized policy offers a deterministic sequence of assortments within the support of the original policy without degrading the performance. Furthermore, we give a variation of our de-randomization algorithm that searches for a deterministic sequence of assortments beyond the support of the original policy. We show that we can implement the latter variation efficiently as long as we can solve the static assortment optimization problem under the choice model governing the choice process of the customers. Either way, if the original policy has a performance guarantee, then the de-randomized policy performs at least just as well. As our crowning technical contribution, we study locally-optimal deterministic policies, where changing any single one of the assortments in the policy does not improve the total expected revenue. We show that any locally-optimal policy has a performance guarantee of 1/2-ϵ when compared with the best sampling-based policy. Noting that the best sampling-based policy has a constant factor performance guarantee, our result yields a fully novel approach for dynamic assortment optimization. Our computational work indicates that a de-randomized policy can substantially improve the original policy and working with assortments beyond the support of the original policy can be quite useful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种去随机化算法，能将任何基于抽样的库存无关动态品类优化策略转化为确定性策略，且性能不降级。进一步，若存在局部最优的确定性策略，其性能保证可达最佳抽样策略的1/2-ϵ。
AI.research_question: 如何将动态品类优化中的基于抽样的库存无关策略去随机化，从而获得确定性序列的品类策略？
AI.motivation: 基于抽样的策略会引入额外的随机性，可能导致平台性能波动并侵蚀用户信任，而去随机化可以消除这一不确定性来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态品类优化、库存无关策略、去随机化算法、局部最优确定性策略、性能保证分析。
AI.method: 提出去随机化算法，将抽样策略转化为确定性品类序列；进一步提出扩展变体，搜索原策略支持外的确定性序列；分析局部最优确定性策略的性能保证。
AI.findings: （1）去随机化后的策略性能不低于原抽样策略；（2）扩展搜索的变体可高效实现；（3）局部最优确定性策略相对于最佳抽样策略有1/2-ϵ的性能保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立去随机化策略与抽样策略之间的性能保证关系，并证明局部最优确定性策略的常数因子性能下界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供确定性品类策略，消除因抽样带来的性能波动，提升平台可信度；计算实验表明去随机化可显著改善原策略表现。

title: Trust as a Scarce Resource: Verification Scarcity, the Competence Trap, and the Economics of Governed AI

detail.title: Trust as a Scarce Resource: Verification Scarcity, the Competence Trap, and the Economics of Governed AI
detail.abstract: AI capability scales computationally; trust scales institutionally. This paper argues that the binding constraint on safe, deployable AI is not generation capacity but verification scarcity: the capacity to validate AI-mediated outputs grows more slowly than the capacity to generate them. We model an organization that deploys an AI agent and allocates costly verification effort to outputs whose error risk is imperfectly observed. Three results organize the analysis. First, under correct beliefs the optimal verification policy never produces a welfare trap: by the envelope theorem, expected loss is monotone in true risk even when undetected risk is not. Second, when verification responds to perceived rather than true risk, undetected risk rises as reliability improves if and only if the product of two elasticities-detection with respect to verification, and verification with respect to perceived risk-exceeds the odds of non-detection. This competence trap condition corrects and sharpens an inequality used informally in deployment practice. Third, when perceived risk is * I thank seminar participants and practitioner colleagues for comments. This paper is part of a companion series on the organizational economics of artificial intelligence (Dogonowski, 2026a,b,c). AI assistance disclosure: drafting, formalization support, and numerical verification scripts were prepared with the assistance of Anthropic's Claude; all analytical results were independently verified numerically in Python by the author, and all errors remain the author's own. 1 itself generated by detected errors, the model exhibits self-confirming equilibria: a zero-verification equilibrium in which nothing is checked, no errors are found, and no checking appears warranted is locally stable whenever hλ 2 r < κ, a threshold in harm, detection efficiency, true risk, and verification cost. Minimum verification floors and independent audits are shown to bound undetected risk and to eliminate the collapse equilibrium. A trust-state dynamic with asymmetric transitions generates hysteresis and rationalizes pilot-to-production failures, symbolic oversight, and abrupt trust collapses as equilibrium phenomena of a single structural constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文论证AI安全部署的核心约束不是生成能力，而是验证稀缺性——验证AI输出的能力增长慢于生成能力。通过建模分析，论文揭示了验证不足导致的"能力陷阱"（可靠性提升反而增加未检测风险）和"零验证均衡"（因不检查而不发现错误，进而认为无需检查）两种低效均衡，并提出验证下限和独立审计等治理方案。
AI.research_question: 当AI输出验证能力滞后于生成能力时，组织如何优化验证资源配置？验证与感知的互动如何导致非均衡结果？
AI.motivation: AI生成能力飞速增长，但验证能力（验证AI输出正确性的能力）相对稀缺，这种不对称可能导致AI部署风险失控。现有文献缺乏对验证稀缺性结构性约束的正式建模分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 验证经济学（验证投入与风险检测的关系）；2. 包络定理（最优验证策略下期望损失对真实风险的单调性）；3. 弹性分析与能力陷阱条件（检测弹性×验证弹性 > 未检测几率）；4. 自我确认均衡理论（零验证均衡的局部稳定性条件）；5. 滞后效应与非对称信任动态。
AI.method: 理论建模（组织部署AI代理并分配验证资源的优化问题），辅以数值验证（作者用Python独立验证所有分析结果）。
AI.findings: 1. 正确信念下，最优验证策略不会产生福利陷阱（包络定理保证期望损失随真实风险单调变化）；2. 当验证响应感知风险而非真实风险时，可靠性提升反而可能增加未检测风险，条件为检测对验证的弹性×验证对感知风险的弹性 > 未检测几率（能力陷阱条件）；3. 存在自我确认的零验证均衡（hλ²r < κ），检查都不检查，错误都不发现，检查似乎不必要；4. 验证下限和独立审计可消除崩溃均衡；5. 信任状态的非对称转换产生滞后效应，可解释试点到生产的失败、象征性监督和信任突然崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次正式建模AI验证稀缺性这一结构性约束；2. 修正并严格化了实践中非正式使用的"能力陷阱"条件；3. 提出自我确认零验证均衡的存在性与稳定性条件；4. 建立信任动态滞后与AI部署失败之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI安全部署中验证资源配置提供量化指导（弹性阈值条件）；2. 建议设置最小验证下限和独立审计以避免零验证均衡；3. 解释"试点成功但上线失败"、"象征性监督"等实践现象的结构性根源；4. 为监管政策设计提供理论依据。

title: Instant Liquidity, Latent Risk
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) and MacroLucid Research

detail.title: Instant Liquidity, Latent Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: We develop a continuous-time model of segmented bond markets to analyze the dual role of fixed-income exchange-traded funds (ETFs). ETFs provide liquidity hedging, compress OTC spreads, and enhance price discovery, particularly when underlying markets are impaired. Yet when authorized participants’ arbitrage capacity weakens, the model generates persistent price dislocations, path-dependent equilibria, and redemption-driven markdowns. This fragility operates through prices and arbitrage breakdown, not investor flows. The model rationalizes the concentration of March 2020 ETF-NAV discounts in safer, more liquid underlying markets. These vulnerabilities grow as ETFs expand across increasingly illiquid and opaque credit markets, with implications for financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个连续时间的分割债券市场模型，分析固收ETF的双重角色：既提供流动性对冲、压缩OTC价差、提升价格发现（尤其当底层市场受损时），又因套利能力减弱导致持续的价格错位、路径依赖均衡和赎回驱动的价格折让。脆弱性通过价格和套利崩溃传导，而非投资者资金流。模型解释了2020年3月ETF-NAV折价集中在更安全、更流动的底层市场这一现象。随着ETF向更不流动、更不透明的信用市场扩张，这些脆弱性加剧，对金融稳定构成影响。
AI.research_question: 固定收益ETF在债券市场中扮演着怎样的双重角色？其流动性提供功能与脆弱性传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 2020年3月新冠疫情引发的市场动荡中，固收ETF出现大幅折价现象，且折价集中在看似更安全、流动性更好的底层市场，这一反直觉现象亟需理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间分割债券市场模型、套利机制、路径依赖均衡理论
AI.method: 连续时间金融理论建模与均衡分析
AI.findings: (1) ETF在正常市场中提供流动性对冲、压缩价差和提升价格发现；(2) 当授权参与者（AP）套利能力减弱时，产生持续价格错位和路径依赖均衡；(3) 脆弱性通过价格机制和套利崩溃传导，而非投资者资金流；(4) 2020年3月折价集中于更安全、更流动的底层市场；(5) 随着ETF向更不流动的信用市场扩张，脆弱性加剧。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上系统揭示了固收ETF的流动性提供机制与脆弱性传导的双重角色，提出了通过价格和套利崩溃而非资金流传导的脆弱性机制，并为2020年3月反直觉的折价现象提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解固收ETF系统性风险提供理论框架，提示随着ETF向不流动信用市场扩张时金融稳定风险的累积，为市场参与者理解ETF折溢价机制和风险管理提供指导。

title: Fitness, Cost, and Return: A Multi-Construct Framework for AI Governance

detail.title: Fitness, Cost, and Return: A Multi-Construct Framework for AI Governance
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Return on AI Investment (ROAI) ratio as a governance construct for AI deployment at organisational scale. The ROAI ratio is defined as the ratio of external fitness improvement attributable to AI deployment to total AI deployment cost — comprising compute cost and governance cost. It integrates three prior measurement constructs — the Q:F ratio (internal output quality relative to external organisational fitness), the IT:HR ratio (compute cost relative to governance cost), and Human Alignment Value (the contribution of human workers to AI alignment) — into a single return measure that addresses the question those constructs do not individually answer: whether AI deployment generates fitness improvement commensurate with its cost. The empirical motivation is drawn from documented cases of AI budget failure. Uber exhausted its entire 2026 AI budget by April after an internal leaderboard incentivised token consumption rather than fitness improvement. Dell Technologies reported that token consumption for reasoning models surged 320 times while token costs fell only 80% year over year. In both cases, output quality was high while ROAI was effectively zero — a pattern this paper terms the ROAI trap. The paper formalises the ROAI ratio, derives a crossover theorem showing that ROAI-governed organisations outperform cost-per-token-governed organisations above an autonomy threshold ρ*, and demonstrates computationally that prompt engineering — reducing token cost without addressing fitness alignment — does not improve organisational fitness. These findings extend the IT business value literature (Melville, Kraemer, and Gurbaxani, 2004) and the AI productivity paradox literature (Brynjolfsson, Rock, and Syverson, 2021) to the context of agentic AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI投资回报率（ROAI）这一治理构念，用于衡量组织级AI部署的效益与成本匹配度，并论证了以ROAI为治理目标的组织在超过自主性阈值后表现优于以单位token成本为治理目标的组织。
AI.research_question: 组织如何衡量AI部署产生的"外部适应性提升"是否与AI部署的总成本（计算成本+治理成本）相匹配？
AI.motivation: Uber提前耗尽AI预算、Dell token消耗激增320倍但成本仅下降80%等案例表明，组织存在"ROAI陷阱"——输出质量高但ROAI实际为零，亟需一个整合性的治理指标来评估AI部署的真实回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: Q:F比率（内部输出质量与外部组织适应性的关系）、IT:HR比率（计算成本与治理成本的关系）、人类对齐价值（人类员工对AI对齐的贡献）
AI.method: 理论形式化推演（ROAI比率定义与交叉定理推导）与计算模拟（提示工程效果仿真）
AI.findings: （1）存在"ROAI陷阱"：输出质量高但ROAI为零；（2）超过自主性阈值ρ*后，ROAI治理优于单位token成本治理；（3）仅降低token成本的提示工程无法提升组织适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将IT商业价值文献和AI生产力悖论文献拓展至智能体AI部署情境，提出了整合性ROAI治理构念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了ROAI比率作为AI部署的治理指标，帮助识别"高输出质量但低ROAI"的陷阱，并指导组织优化AI投资决策。

title: Fiscal Policy Design under Market Power: Productivity Shocks, Fiscal Rules, and the Value of State-Contingency

detail.title: Fiscal Policy Design under Market Power: Productivity Shocks, Fiscal Rules, and the Value of State-Contingency
detail.abstract: This paper studies fiscal policy design in economies with imperfect product-market competition and productivity shocks. A static general equilibrium benchmark with Cournot competition generates a markup wedge, public expenditure financed by lump-sum taxation, and households that value private consumption, leisure, and public expenditure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在不完全竞争产品市场和生产率冲击下的财政政策设计。通过一个带有古诺竞争、一次性税收融资公共支出以及重视私人消费、休闲和公共支出的家庭的静态一般均衡基准模型，分析了加价楔子的产生及其对财政政策的影响。
AI.research_question: 在不完全竞争产品市场和生产率冲击的经济体中，如何设计最优财政政策？
AI.motivation: 现实经济中产品市场往往存在不完全竞争（如寡头垄断），这会导致价格加价和市场扭曲。理解在这种环境下财政政策如何发挥作用，对于制定有效的经济政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静态一般均衡模型、古诺竞争模型、加价楔子理论
AI.method: 构建包含古诺竞争的静态一般均衡基准模型，引入生产率冲击，分析财政政策（公共支出与一次性税收）在经济中的传导机制和最优设计。
AI.findings: 不完全竞争市场中的加价行为会产生一个"加价楔子"，扭曲资源配置；在此背景下，财政政策的设计需要考虑到市场不完全竞争带来的效率损失，以及生产率冲击对经济的动态影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产品市场不完全竞争（古诺竞争）引入财政政策分析框架，揭示了加价楔子如何影响财政政策的传导机制和最优设计，丰富了新古典综合派财政理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在面对不完全竞争市场和生产率冲击时，如何设计最优的公共支出规模和税收结构提供了理论依据和政策参考。

title: The Role of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in Strengthening Corporate Governance: A Critical Analysis of Recent CSR Amendments and Emerging Compliance Trends in India

detail.title: The Role of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in Strengthening Corporate Governance: A Critical Analysis of Recent CSR Amendments and Emerging Compliance Trends in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing financial or non-financial interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based solely on publicly available secondary sources and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Accordingly, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: Adopting a doctrinal research methodology, the paper finds that recent reforms have strengthened corporate governance by enhancing board oversight, improving implementing agency accountability, and intensifying regulatory enforcement. However, persistent challenges remain, including disproportionate compliance burdens on newly covered companies, insufficient outcome-based monitoring, and the complexity of managing parallel CSR and ESG reporting regimes. The central hypothesis-that recent amendments would strengthen corporate governance in India-is substantially supported, though long-term efficacy will depend on a decisive shift from expenditure-based compliance towards impact-oriented governance. This study contributes to contemporary CSR scholarship by examining the governance implications of the 2025 and 2026 CSR reforms and evaluating their impact on accountability mechanisms within the Indian corporate regulatory framework.

AI.tldr: 本文采用教义学研究方法，分析了印度2025年和2026年CSR改革对公司治理的影响。研究发现，改革通过增强董事会监督、改进执行机构问责和加强监管执行来强化公司治理，但仍存在合规负担不均、结果导向监督不足及CSR与ESG报告并行管理等挑战。长期效果取决于从支出合规向影响导向治理的转变。
AI.research_question: 印度2025年和2026年CSR改革是否以及如何加强了公司治理？改革对问责机制产生了何种影响？
AI.motivation: 近年来印度CSR监管框架经历了重大改革（2025年和2026年），但关于这些改革对公司治理实际影响的系统性研究不足，需要通过教义学方法进行深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教义学研究方法论（doctrinal research methodology），公司治理理论，问责机制理论，CSR与ESG治理框架。
AI.method: 教义学研究方法（doctrinal research methodology），即对法律法规、判例和监管文件进行系统性的法律文本分析与解释。
AI.findings: （1）改革通过增强董事会监督、改进执行机构问责和加强监管执行，确实强化了公司治理；（2）但仍存在三大挑战：新纳入公司面临不成比例的合规负担、缺乏以结果为导向的监督机制、CSR与ESG报告并行管理带来的复杂性；（3）改革的中心假设——近期修订将强化印度公司治理——得到了实质性支持；（4）长期效果取决于从支出合规向影响导向治理的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为当代CSR学术研究提供了关于印度2025年和2026年CSR改革治理影响的新证据，丰富了公司治理与CSR交叉领域的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了改革效果评估与改进方向，指出需要从支出合规转向影响导向治理，并为新兴经济体CSR监管改革提供了参考经验。

title: No Single Law, No Vacuum: Director Duties and AI Under Existing Canadian Law

detail.title: No Single Law, No Vacuum: Director Duties and AI Under Existing Canadian Law

declarations.ethicsApproval: This article reflects the law and regulatory developments as of June 2026, including the federal AI for All strategy (released June 4, 2026) and Bill C-36 (introduced June 15, 2026). Readers should note that Bill C-36 was at first reading at the time of writing and may be amended prior to enactment.

detail.abstract:
Canada does not have a single, comprehensive statute governing artificial intelligence. The proposed Artificial Intelligence and Data Act died on the order paper in January 2025 and has not been reintroduced. This absence is frequently treated, in both practice and commentary, as a regulatory gap. This article argues that it is not. 
The directors of Canadian corporations already owe duties that reach AI risk, grounded in the duty of care under section 122 of the Canada Business Corporations Act, and reinforced by provincial and federal privacy law, human rights and employment legislation, securities disclosure rules, and sector-specific prudential guidance such as the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions' Guideline E-23. Drawing on Canada's newly released national AI strategy, the privacy reform introduced via Bill C-36, and two existing Canadian decisions (Moffatt v Air Canada and the Clearview AI litigation ), this article demonstrates that Canadian courts and regulators are already applying established legal principles to AI conduct, well ahead of any comprehensive AI statute. It closes with a practical governance framework for boards, in-house counsel, and compliance functions at financial institutions, mid-market companies, and private corporations, arguing that the absence of a single AI law is not a basis for delay but a more demanding standard of director conduct in its own right.

AI.tldr: 本文论证加拿大并不缺少AI监管法规，企业董事基于既有公司法、隐私法、人权法等法律，已负有涵盖AI风险的信义义务。文章结合新发布的AI国家战略、隐私改革法案及判例（如Moffatt诉Air Canada、Clearview AI案），指出现有法律原则已适用于AI行为，并提出董事会及合规部门应采用的实践治理框架。
AI.research_question: 加拿大是否真的缺少针对人工智能（AI）的监管？企业董事在缺乏单一AI综合法规的情况下，是否已负有与AI相关的法律义务？
AI.motivation: 加拿大《人工智能与数据法案》未获通过，实践中常被视作"监管空白"。本文旨在反驳这一普遍认知，指出既有法律体系已对AI行为形成有效规制，以避免企业因等待专门立法而延误合规行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于加拿大《商业公司法》第122条董事注意义务，结合隐私法、人权法、就业法、证券披露规则及行业审慎监管指引（如OSFI Guideline E-23），形成多层次法律义务框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、判例分析（Moffatt v Air Canada、Clearview AI案）、政策文件分析（国家AI战略、C-36法案）。
AI.findings: 加拿大法院和监管机构已在缺乏单一AI综合法规的情况下，将既有法律原则适用于AI行为；董事的注意义务已涵盖AI风险管理；"无法规"不等于"无义务"，反而可能对董事行为提出更高标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战"监管空白"的主流叙事，提出"既有法律已足以规制AI"的理论观点；将传统董事信义义务理论延伸至AI治理领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构、中型市场公司和私营企业的董事会、法务及合规部门提供了现成的AI治理实践框架；警示企业不得以"等待专项AI立法"为由拖延风险管理。

title: The Price of Exclusion: Regional Institutions and Sovereign Risk in a Currency Union
affiliations: University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business

detail.title: The Price of Exclusion: Regional Institutions and Sovereign Risk in a Currency Union
detail.abstract: What is the value of membership in an integrated financial architecture, and what does a sovereign lose when access to that architecture is withdrawn? We answer this question using the recent coup wave in the West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU), which generated rare variation in sovereign access to a shared regional financial architecture while holding constant the common currency, central bank, sovereign debt market, banking system, and equity exchange. We show that markets price access rather than political turnover itself. Sovereigns experiencing access-preserving coups exhibit little durable repricing, whereas exclusion from the regional funding architecture generates a large and persistent sovereign re-entry premium. We interpret this premium as the revealed value of an institutional convenience yield associated with access to a shared investor base and market infrastructure. The effects extend beyond sovereign debt markets: bank equities embedded in the same financial architecture fall sharply at access loss but not at accesspreserving coups. We further provide suggestive evidence that exclusion is accompanied by creditor realignment rather than a collapse in foreign participation. Together, the results identify a previously difficult-to-measure financing benefit generated by membership in an integrated financial architecture and show how its loss is capitalized across sovereign debt and bank equity.

AI.tldr: 利用西非经济货币联盟（WAEMU）近期政变潮中主权国家获取区域金融架构渠道的罕见变异，研究发现市场定价的是融资渠道而非政治更迭本身：保留渠道的政变对主权债定价影响甚微，而被排除在区域融资架构之外则产生巨大且持久的主权重新进入溢价。这一溢价被解释为获取共享投资者基础和基础设施所带来的制度性便利收益的价值。
AI.research_question: 一体化金融架构成员身份的价值是什么？当主权国家失去对该架构的访问权时会损失什么？
AI.motivation: 利用WAEMU近期政变潮提供的自然实验——在共同货币、央行、主权债市场、银行体系和股票交易所保持恒定的情况下，主权国家获取区域金融架构的渠道发生了罕见的变异——来识别和量化金融架构成员身份的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度性便利收益（institutional convenience yield）：与获取共享投资者基础和基础设施相关的价值；资本市场定价理论；主权债务定价与政治风险理论。
AI.method: 利用WAEMU政变潮作为自然实验，对比"保留渠道的政变"与"被排除在外的政变"对主权债和银行股票价格的不同影响，进行事件研究分析。
AI.findings: （1）市场定价的是融资渠道而非政治更迭本身；（2）保留渠道的政变对主权债定价影响甚微；（3）被排除在外则产生巨大且持久的主权重新进入溢价；（4）同一金融架构内的银行股票在失去渠道时大幅下跌，但在保留渠道的政变中则无此现象；（5）被排除伴随着债权人重新调整而非外国参与崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并量化了一体化金融架构成员身份产生的、此前难以测量的融资收益；揭示了金融架构接入权如何被资本化到主权债和银行股票价格中；区分了政治风险与金融架构风险的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估区域金融一体化收益提供量化依据；为投资者理解主权债定价中的制度性便利收益提供参考；对国际金融机构和区域金融架构设计具有启示意义。

title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Bocconi University, Australian National University (ANU) and

detail.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
detail.abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing "nudges" and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较1200多个行为干预（助推）与传统价格干预的实证估计，发现行为干预的效果在转化为等价格变化后相当于巨大的财政干预（如11%的电税或100%的疫苗补贴），且成本效益更高，但价格干预在规模上产生更大的总剩余。
AI.research_question: 行为干预（助推）相对于传统价格干预的经济意义有多大？两种政策工具的福利效应如何排序？
AI.motivation: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心，但其实证效果常被认为较小，研究旨在通过将助推效果转化为等价格变化来评估其经济意义，并比较两种工具的福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为扩展的公共资金边际价值（Marginal Value of Public Funds, MVPF）框架
AI.method: 元分析：收集60多个研究中1200多个关于助推与价格干预的估计，涵盖香烟、酒精、流感疫苗、电力和住宅用水五个市场。
AI.findings: 1）行为干预效果在转化为等价格变化后相当于巨大的财政干预（如11%的电税、100%的疫苗补贴）；2）助推在所有市场中成本效益更高；3）成本效益不能预测政策的福利排序；4）助推在边际上有较高的福利回报，而价格干预在规模上产生更大的总剩余。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了行为公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架，为比较行为干预与价格干预的福利效应提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了比较行为干预与价格干预经济意义的方法，指出助推虽成本效益高但价格干预在规模上福利更大，有助于政策选择。

title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and

detail.title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
detail.abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国合格小型企业股票（QSBS）税收减免政策的变化，研究发现税收补贴促使风险投资（VC）投资者承担更多风险：他们更多投资于早期、高风险的初创企业，尽管失败率更高，但成功企业的估值和"独角兽"比例也更高；而非VC投资者未表现出类似行为。税收补贴还导致资本向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更有影响力的专利。
AI.research_question: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担更多风险？具体而言，QSBS税收减免政策如何影响VC投资者和非VC投资者的风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 税收政策对风险投资行为的影响是公共财政和创业金融领域的重要问题。此前缺乏利用准自然实验方法识别税收补贴对投资者风险承担因果效应的研究，尤其是区分VC（管理他人资金）与非VC（管理自有资金）投资者在面对相同税收激励时的行为差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托代理理论（VC管理外部资金，存在激励补偿机制）与投资者自有资金投资的行为差异，分析税收补贴通过改变税后收益预期对风险偏好的影响。
AI.method: 使用Bunching分析、三重差分（triple-differences）和匹配设计，利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求的变化，分析20年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据。
AI.findings: (1) 税收补贴导致投资者在持有期阈值处出现策略性"聚集"；(2) VC投资者将项目选择转向风险更高的初创企业（更多投资于商业化前阶段、成为首轮投资者、投资有存量债务的初创企业，减少联合投资）；(3) 税收补贴支持的VC企业失败率更高，但成功企业估值更高、更易成为"独角兽"；(4) 非VC投资者无类似行为；(5) 税收激励导致资本重新配置到更具创新性的行业，产生更有影响力的专利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过因果识别方法证明税收政策可以改变创业融资结构，促使资本向风险更高、创新性更强、价值更高的初创企业重新配置；揭示了VC与非VC投资者在税收激励下的行为异质性，丰富了委托代理框架下税收激励影响风险承担的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计税收补贴工具以引导风险资本支持高成长、高创新企业提供了实证依据；提示税收补贴在促进创新的同时需权衡更高的失败率风险。

title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: A Toolkit for Applied Micro
affiliations: University of Chicago,  and University of Oxford

detail.title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: A Toolkit for Applied Micro
detail.abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect - after correcting for selectivity - is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文为研究者提供了一个元分析工具包，用于总结已有文献、预测新情境中的效应大小，并纠正选择性偏误。通过多领域实证案例展示，校正后平均效应仅为简单均值的12%-21%。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地利用已有研究来预测新情境中的效应大小，并纠正文献中的选择性偏误？
AI.motivation: 研究者常需基于已有文献预测效应大小，但现有文献存在选择性偏倚（如仅发表显著结果），且缺乏统一的预测方法论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元分析（Meta-analysis）、选择性偏误校正、重加权预测方法。
AI.method: 提出一套包含三部分的分析工具：（i）文献总结；（ii）利用协变量对已有估计进行重加权，实现对新情境的透明预测；（iii）校正选择性偏误。通过劳动、公共、行为、环境和发展经济学多个实证案例进行验证。
AI.findings: 校正选择性偏误后，平均效应大小仅为简单均值的12%-21%；即使在仅有3项先验研究的情况下，部分工具仍然适用；利用协变量重加权可透明地进行新情境预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 为元分析方法提供了系统的选择性偏误校正框架，拓展了在小样本（如3项研究）下进行元分析的可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了可直接操作的"食谱式"元分析指南，帮助研究者更准确地预测新情境中的效应大小，避免因选择性偏误高估效应。

title: Causal Inference for Social Network Formation
affiliations: University of Oxford, Harvard University and UCL School of Management, University College London

detail.title: Causal Inference for Social Network Formation
detail.abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套基于设计的因果识别框架，利用网络随时间变化的重复观测数据和初始联系的随机变动，来识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成的因果机制，并以一家大型专业服务公司的随机新员工分配数据进行了实证检验。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和估计驱动内生社交网络形成的因果机制？
AI.motivation: 社交网络形成存在未观测混淆变量和反向因果问题，传统方法难以进行因果识别；同时均衡和抽样问题使推断复杂化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于设计的方法（design-based approach），将节点集和潜在结果视为非随机的，利用时间序列上的重复观测和初始联系的随机变化进行因果识别。
AI.method: 利用一家大型专业服务公司中新员工被随机分配到不同项目团队的数据，采用设计为基础的因果推断方法。
AI.findings: 间接联系对联系形成有强烈且显著的正向因果效应，而网络度和局部密度的效应较小且不够稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种规避传统抽样和渐近理论难题的设计型因果推断框架，为社交网络形成的因果识别提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业理解员工社交网络的形成机制、优化团队配置和促进知识流动提供了实证依据。
